sources: City of Chicago, Boundaries – Community Areas (igwz-8jzy)

pilsen-brick.about: Red and brown brick 2-3 flats and worker cottages, cream-brick storefronts, stone churches, brick and concrete warehouses by the river

worker-cottage.about: Frame and brick worker cottages with pitched roofs, painted siding, brick two-flats, corner taverns and churches; industry along the river

greystone-flats.about: Greystone and brick two- and three-flats, brick apartment courts, mansions on the boulevards

chinatown.about: Painted and red brick storefronts and walk-ups, newer mid-rises

brick-two-flat.about: Brick two- and three-flats, frame cottages, corner storefronts, converted lofts

lincoln-brownstone.about: Greystones, brownstones and brick three-flats, frame cottages, courtyard buildings, lakefront high-rises

loft-district.about: Brick warehouse lofts, newer glass and concrete mid- and high-rises

campus.about: University campus: modernist concrete and brick halls, older brick houses around it

lakefront-highrise.about: Greystone and brownstone row houses and mansions among lakefront apartment towers

loop-masonry.about: The Loop: terracotta, limestone and brick Chicago School office blocks, Art Deco towers, modern glass skyscrapers

streeterville-glass.about: Streeterville and the Magnificent Mile: limestone and greystone pre-war towers, lakefront glass and concrete high-rises

printers-row-brick.about: Printers Row: brick and terracotta printing lofts

statuses.todo: Inside the circle, not finished yet
